description: This Java source file defines the CommandHeaderInvalidException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate invalid command headers. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and a builder class for constructing exceptions.

classes.name: CommandHeaderInvalidException
